value.rationale: The seven-point Kneser triple complex is the smallest case with nonzero sixth rational homology. Its prior rank 29 does not distinguish representations. The new full S7 module splits as a unique invariant line and two conjugate 14-dimensional Specht modules, implying that its non-free geometric quotient is a rational homology six-sphere. This gives symmetry information and an exact topological quotient consequence of direct relevance to the recent degree-six generator problem, without claiming an unrestricted family classification.
